  -- Thought: Needed to confirm the directors' nationalities to determine if they share the same nationality.
  -- Result: Identified Howard Hawks as the director of Fig Leaves (1926) and Stephen Kay as the director of Boogeyman (2005), both American.

- Agent: Planner
